name: dapp-frontend-check
description: dApp front-end check: reads the JavaScript, TypeScript, JSON and env files of a decentralized app's front end or off-chain service as text, runs nothing, calls no node and fetches nothing, and lists risky Web3 integration patterns with file, line and column as an input to a review of how the app talks to wallets and chains: private keys and seed phrases in source or env files (never printed), RPC addresses with an API key, unlimited approvals and permits, eth_sign, messages built from fields and signed as text, typed data domains with no chainId or verifyingContract, wallet code that never looks at the chain, addresses that fail the EIP-55 checksum, addresses repeated outside one map, one contract name with two addresses for one chain, window.web3, ethereum.enable() and eth_accounts with no request for accounts, HTML built from token metadata, and waits for one confirmation against a setting of more. Text, JSON, CSV and GitHub annotation output, exit codes for a pipeline, no dependencies.
author: INNERLUXES <info@innerluxes.dev>
